mechanism: Foscarnet causes electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia) that increase risk of QT prolongation and cardiac arrhythmias, compounded by amitriptyline's own cardiotoxic effects and anticholinergic properties.
action: Monitor cardiac function closely with ECG; assess electrolytes regularly; consider alternative antiviral or antidepressant if possible; avoid other QT-prolonging agents.
